summary: Pass 3 of 3 (bounce budget spent; passes with residuals, escalate: true set in loop-count.json). All ten of pass 2's findings (Issues 11-20) are genuinely fixed, verified against the real DashboardComponents.swift: the nudge control is now unambiguously a ZStack sibling of the chat Button (never nested in its label, with the accessibility-element-collapse reason stated), it reuses the already-shipped defaulted onNudge (L251) and shared NudgeUIState enum (L472-478) rather than inventing parallels, .rateLimited now renders as .sent with Theme.error reserved for .failed exactly as CheckInRow does, and the hollow badge's contrast was recomputed rather than deferred -- I independently re-derived it at ~5.53:1, within rounding of the spec's 5.49. Every line citation, token value, and geometric claim checks out. Six residuals documented rather than looped; one is substantive: the badge and nudge cutout circles are specified as 'same fill as tile', but Issue 1's fix made that fill a 94%-transparent goldLight@0.06 wash, so the cutouts will tint the friend's photo by 6% instead of occluding it -- defeating the style brief's signature 'cut out of the avatar' technique and making the on-tile contrast math unverifiable wherever the tokens overlap the avatar. One-line implementation fix given (mask the circles out of AvatarView with blendMode(.destinationOut) in a compositingGroup, which stays robust to the unmeasured parent material). Also residual: a padding/hit-frame ambiguity that would land the control ~10pt off its stated (51,17) center, a ~7pt invisible nudge hit-annulus over a 68pt chat target with no undo (device look), an unconditional VoiceOver nudge action that fires while the visible control is disabled, and two minor derivation/device-check items. Carried forward for the user: five behavior-altering decisions (notably making a previously decorative row tappable) are still pipeline-made not user-confirmed, the 24h 'recent activity' window is arbitrary, nudging remains fire-and-forget with no confirm or undo, and the sibling /build task 20260906-friend-nudges still needs to drive the new nudgeStates map and wire the control.
